lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in three to four discernible horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like coordinate system of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow immediately ventral, following a horizontal trajectory.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance blobs across its visible surface, with higher concentrations observed towards the distal tip.
